---
title: "Search strategy"
---

This page records the search, as PRISMA-S requires [@rethlefsen2021]. The counts are the records each database returned before deduplication. [01-deduplication](../analysis/01-deduplication.ipynb) writes the identification counts for the flow diagram from the exports in `data/raw/search_exports/` once the exports are in.

## Query

The query is a form of *share* or *open* within five words of *data*, together with a word beginning *research* or *scienti*, in titles and abstracts. A distance of five words is sufficient for phrasings such as "sharing of research data" and "openly available data". The results comprise 110,847 records across PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science, of which 60,852 are unique by DOI or by title and year. Of the 25 test sources in these databases, 21 are among the results (0.84, 95% interval 0.65 to 0.94).

In Scopus and Web of Science the search also covers author keywords. It covers sources published from 2015 to 2025 in English and French and applies no document type filter.

| Database | Records |
|:--|--:|
| PubMed | 14,371 |
| Scopus | 55,738 |
| Web of Science | 40,738 |
| **Total** | **110,847** |

: Records the query returned on 25 November 2026 through each database's API, before deduplication. Matched on DOI, or on title and year, they come to 60,852. The Web of Science count omits the language limit, which its API rejects beside a proximity search. {#tbl-records}

Platforms and search dates for the exports are to be added.

## Development and testing

**Method.** We tested candidate queries against known relevant sources, following the development and validation set approach of @hausner2012. The known sources are the 76 sources included by @chawinga2019 that meet this review's criteria apart from year. We rebuilt their list from the paper with a script, and checked each source against the criteria with a local language model. Sources published 2007 to 2014 form the development set: 45 sources, 35 of them indexed in at least one database. Sources published from 2015 form the test set: 31 sources, 25 indexed. We counted test sources while choosing the query's terms and their distance from *data*, so the test result below is not independent of those choices.

We ran each candidate in PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science and recorded two counts: the records it returns for 2015 to 2025 in English or French, and the development and test sources it finds by DOI or PMID. Every measurement here can be checked or rerun in the [search development notebook](../analysis/00_search-development/00-search-development.ipynb), which holds each run with its code and files.

**Candidates compared.**

| Search | PubMed | Scopus | Web of Science | Total |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| share NEAR/5 data | 18,840 | 82,926 | 62,228 | 163,994 |
| (share NEAR/5 data) AND (research\* OR scienti\*) | 9,194 | 31,681 | 22,764 | 63,639 |
| **(share NEAR/5 data OR open\* NEAR/5 data) AND (research\* OR scienti\*)** | **14,371** | **55,738** | **40,738** | **110,847** |

: Records for 2015 to 2025, before deduplication, on 25 November 2026. {#tbl-candidates tbl-colwidths="[64,9,9,9,9]"}

**Results.** Of the 25 test sources in the databases, the query finds nine of 11 in PubMed, 20 of 23 in Scopus and 13 of 18 in Web of Science, and 21 in at least one database, a relative recall of 0.84 (95% interval 0.65 to 0.94). It misses Chiware and Mathe (2016) and Wittenberg and Elings (2017), which concern research data management; Watson (2015), which concerns open science; and Houtkoop et al. (2018), which has no word beginning *research* or *scienti*.

**Limits.** We chose the query partly on the test sources, so 0.84 overstates its recall. The test set is small and its sources date from 2015 to 2018, so it gives no estimate of recall for 2019 to 2025.

**Peer review.** A McGill health sciences librarian reviewed the search approach on 27 October 2026.

## Search strings

### Generic query

```text
Title/abstract: share* NEAR/5 data OR open* NEAR/5 data
AND
Title/abstract: research* OR scienti*

Limits: published 2015 to 2025; English or French
```

### PubMed

PubMed's proximity search takes no truncation, so the PubMed string spells out four forms of *share* and five forms of *open*.

```text
(
  ("sharing data"[tiab:~5] OR "shared data"[tiab:~5] OR "share data"[tiab:~5] OR "shares data"[tiab:~5]
   OR "open data"[tiab:~5] OR "opened data"[tiab:~5] OR "opening data"[tiab:~5] OR "openly data"[tiab:~5] OR "openness data"[tiab:~5])
  AND (research*[tiab] OR scienti*[tiab])
)
AND 2015:2025[dp]
AND (english[la] OR french[la])
```

### Scopus

```text
( TITLE-ABS-KEY ( shar* W/5 data ) OR TITLE-ABS-KEY ( open* W/5 data ) )
AND TITLE-ABS-KEY ( research* OR scienti* )
AND PUBYEAR > 2014 AND PUBYEAR < 2026
AND LANGUAGE ( english OR french )
```

### Web of Science

```text
( TS=( shar* NEAR/5 data ) OR TS=( open* NEAR/5 data ) )
AND TS=( research* OR scienti* )
AND PY=(2015-2025)
AND LA=(English OR French)
```

## Export file names

Name each export `<database>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.<ext>`, for example `scopus_2026-11-18.ris`. The date is the search date. Supported formats are RIS and CSV. See the README in `data/raw/search_exports/`.
